jordan_cust: Hey team — our embeddings suddenly changed after we shifted some traffic to Dedicated. Hosted returns 1536-d vectors, Dedicated returns 1024-d. This is breaking our downstream RAG index. Anyone seen this?

sophia_support: Sorry you're hitting this, @jordan_cust. Can you paste an example response from each? Also which model name you're calling?

jordan_cust: Sure — call looks identical. Model param: `redwood-embed-large-v1`. Hosted response (truncated): `embedding_length: 1536, sample: [0.001, -0.02, ...]`

jordan_cust: Dedicated response (truncated): `embedding_length: 1024, sample: [0.005, -0.011, ...]`

ashwin_eng: @sophia_support tagging runtime — that smells like a model variant mismatch or a fallback. Can you repro locally with headers that target each deployment?

sophia_support: Jordan — can you run both calls with the small curl below and paste the full response headers? We want to see `x-redwood-model` and any `x-redwood-route` metadata.

sophia_support: ```
# Hosted
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-large-v1","input":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings

# Dedicated (hit your reserved endpoint or set header)
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEDICATED_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Deployment: dedicated" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-large-v1","input":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
```

jordan_cust: Pasting hosted response headers: `x-redwood-model: redwood-embed-large-v1@1.1.0`, `x-redwood-route: hosted-primary`, `content-length: 987`

jordan_cust: Dedicated headers: `x-redwood-model: redwood-embed-large-compact@1.0.0`, `x-redwood-route: fallback-compact`, `content-length: 812`

maria_ops: Whoa — dedicated call routed to `redwood-embed-large-compact`. That's our compact/fallback variant with 1024 dims. Looks like the routing policy kicked in when capacity was constrained. @ashwin_eng can you check why the fallback mapping didn't preserve dims or why a fallback happened silently?

ashwin_eng: Confirmed in the logs for the customer's tenant id: we saw `route_decision: fallback-compact` at 2026-03-26T15:02:12Z. The fallback is allowed by policy when CPU/GPU pressure hits X%. But we should be surfacing that in the response. Currently we only set `x-redwood-route`. Not all SDKs check it.

liam_ml: Root cause: compact variant is a different model family (smaller embedding head) — dimension change expected. This is intended behavior for graceful degradation but it's terrible for clients relying on fixed vector dims. We should (a) make fallback preserve dims via a projection (not trivial), or (b) make fallback opt-in and return an explicit error/warning.

sophia_support: For a fast mitigation for Jordan: 1) Pin model version on Dedicated to `redwood-embed-large-v1@1.1.0` in your Dedicated config (we can assist). 2) Add a request header `X-Redwood-Fallback: deny` to disable fallback routing. 3) We'll open a ticket to avoid silent fallback.

jordan_cust: Thanks. How do I pin the model? I don't have access to Dedicated config UI.

maria_ops: We can update the customer's dedicated mapping on our side. I'll do a temp change to pin to `redwood-embed-large-v1@1.1.0` for tenant `tj-482`. Doing it now...

deploy-bot: deploy started for mapping-update tj-482 -> pin redwood-embed-large-v1@1.1.0 (deploy id: deploy-98431)

maria_ops: Done — mapping updated and deployed. Jordan can you retry the Dedicated call?

jordan_cust: Re-ran the curl. Dedicated headers now show `x-redwood-model: redwood-embed-large-v1@1.1.0`, `x-redwood-route: dedicated-primary`. Response embedding_length: 1536. Looks fixed, thanks! :tada:

ashwin_eng: Follow-ups: (1) Runtime: stop silent fallback for embeddings that change vector length — must either reject request or add explicit flag to allow. (2) Console: surface `x-redwood-route`/model variant in the usage logs and alert when fallback occurs. (3) DevEx/docs: add note about vector-dimension invariants and guidance for pinning.

liam_ml: I'll draft a brief doc about projection vs hard-fail tradeoffs and recommended customer settings.

sophia_support: Created ticket #INC-2026-981 with notes and assigned to eng-runtime. Jordan — we'll keep this open until you confirm no further issues over next 24 hours.

jordan_cust: Appreciate the quick turnaround. One ask: can you also add a warning to our account when a fallback happens? That would let us catch it faster in future.

maria_ops: Noted — adding account-level alert request to the ticket.

sophia_support: Closing loop: mitigation applied, eng-runtime owns prevention work, support will monitor. Thanks everyone.
